list.title: Inventory
list.description: On-hand valuation and stock movements — costed FIFO, moving-average, or standard.
list.emptyDescription: Configure an item's costing profile in Setup, then receive stock.

drawer.title: Inventory movement

hint.receive: Add stock at cost (DR inventory / CR offset).
hint.issue: Remove stock to COGS (DR COGS / CR inventory).
hint.adjust: Correct on-hand quantity against the adjustment account.
hint.transfer: Move stock between two locations at its carried cost.
hint.build: Consume components per the BOM and produce the finished good at cost.
hint.landed: Capitalize freight/duty onto an item’s on-hand layers.

drawer.offsetHint: The account credited for the receipt (clearing / GRNI / opening balance).
drawer.missingFields: Item, location, and quantity are required
drawer.freightHint: The account the freight currently sits in; it moves into inventory.
